'''LS-412''' was a [[human]] [[Gender|male]] [[scout trooper]] that served in the [[Stormtrooper Corps]] of the [[Galactic Empire]]. In [[1 BBY]], he and his comrade [[LS-515]] were knocked out by the rebel [[Garazeb Orrelios]] while patrolling the perimeters of the [[Lothal Jedi Temple]]. His armor was stolen by the [[Jedi]] [[Padawan]] [[Ezra Bridger]], who used it to infiltrate the camp.

==Biography==
LS-412 was a [[Gender|male]] [[scout trooper]] who along with his comrade [[LS-515]] were assigned to patrol the joint [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] and [[Mining Guild]] [[Excavation of the Lothal Jedi Temple|excavation camp]] at the [[Lothal Jedi Temple]]. While he and LS-515 were patrolling the perimeter on [[614-AvA speeder bike]]s, they stumbled upon a [[Hologram|holographic projection]] of [[Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo|Thrawn]] from the [[Battle of Atollon]]. When they went to investigate, they were attacked and knocked unconscious by the [[Lasat]] [[Garazeb Orrelios]], a member of the [[Spectres]] rebel cell.<ref name="Wolves and a Door" />

The rebel [[Ezra Bridger]] stole his armor and [[speeder bike]] while the [[Mandalorian]] [[Sabine Wren]] posed as LS-515. Despite the presence of the rebel impostors, the absence of the two scout troopers was noted by a [[stormtrooper]], who noticed that the two had deviated from their patrol route and never finished their perimeter sweep. Disguised as LS-412, Ezra was able to unlock the [[Painting of the Mortis gods]],<ref name="Wolves and a Door" /> which led to the mystical [[World Between Worlds]].<ref name="A World between Worlds">{{Rebels|A World Between Worlds}}</ref>

==Personality and traits==
LS-412 was a [[Gender|male]] [[scout trooper]]<ref name="ECUC" /> who wore white armor over a black uniform. He rode a 614-AvA speeder bike as part of Imperial military patrols around the Lothal Jedi Temple.<ref name="Wolves and a Door" />

==Behind the scenes==
LS-412 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|Season Four]] episode "[[Wolves and a Door]]," which first premiered on [[February 26]], [[2018]]. Despite not speaking in this episode [[Dave Filoni]] is credited for playing a Imperial Scout trooper.<ref name="Wolves and a Door" />
